claim: On Nightmare 1, three minutes of play mostly gets its damage from weapons picked up at level-ups and chests, not from the starting weapon.
evidence: L1.I1.G1: chip-shuriken 11864 and hot-potato 5528 against fry-knives 1886. L1.I1.G5: hot-potato 10186 against mezzaluna 1109. L1.I1.G3: tot-stampede 5970 against hash-boomerang 4763.

claim: Hot-potato and chip-shuriken are strong early picks at Nightmare 1, and the games that opened a chest in the first 2 minutes did best.
evidence: L1.I1.G1 (4 chests, 1195 kills) and L1.I1.G5 (hot-potato 585 kills, 951 total) survived. G2 and G4 opened no chest and died.

claim: Starting fry-knives with a bundle of low-damage passives (gravy-heart, chives, spud-sneakers, big-bowl) and no extra weapon died by 1:50. It dealt 646 damage in its first two minutes, against 8931 for plain fry-knives.
evidence: L1.I1.G2 against G1, same seed 11. This is one game, and its level-ups and routes differed (level 4 against 13).

claim: Tater-mines alone is weak in the opening and died at 2:03 without opening a chest. Only 204 shots fired and kills came slowly.
evidence: L1.I1.G4: 349 kills against about 1000 in the surviving games.

claim: Steam-vent at level 8 with root-network evolves into Pressure Cooker at the first chest, and the evolution deals heavy damage and keeps Tibo near full health.
evidence: L1.I2.G5: evolved at 63.8s, pressure-cooker 7148 damage and 337 kills, health 120/120 at 3:00, 56 damage taken.

claim: Starch-chain with hot-sauce evolves into Gratin Arc, which becomes the top damage source within 35 s of evolving. Seeker-sprouts + fertilizer + thick-skin was the highest-kill start (1333).
evidence: L1.I2.G2: gratin-arc at 2:27 dealt 8654 damage and 468 kills, with starch-chain 7746 before it; 5 chests opened, first at 0:41.

claim: At dashThreshold 0.5 the bot dashes rarely and only when health is already low. Whether more dashing helps is still unproven.
evidence: Full run: 8 dashes, all at 28% health or less (dash scores 51-57%), including 5 in the last 25 seconds; none stopped the boss or swarm. Earlier rows unchanged.

claim: Spud-cannon with hot-sauce, sprouting-eyes and starch-plating takes less damage and keeps health higher than spud-cannon alone.
evidence: L1.I2.G4 against G3, same seed 11: damage taken 68 against 113, health 112/120 against 57/120, kills 848 against 700.

claim: Hot-streak with movement passives (lean-lunch, tater-trot, masher-grip) deals heavy damage on Nightmare 1 while taking almost none, and needs hardly any action-model moves.
evidence: L1.I3.G2: hot-streak 9520 damage and 538 kills, 895 kills in total, 13 damage taken, 20 model-asked moves, health 114/120.

claim: Seed-potato with fertilizer evolves into Potato Patch at the first chest, and hash-hawk with bacon-bits evolves into Hash Harrier; both were among the top damage sources.
evidence: L1.I3.G4: potato-patch at 78.9 s dealt 5718 damage and 339 kills, hash-harrier at 150 s dealt 4468, 982 kills, health 120/120, level 13.

claim: A start with no chest opened in the first 90 s is the common thread of the early deaths. Tot-toss with gem-sling, magnet and grip died at 1:37 with zero chests.
evidence: L1.I3.G1: 0 chests, 122 kills, first chest listed 1:11, health under 25% from 1:05. Same pattern as L1.I1.G2 and G4 (see B2).

claim: Fry-sentry at level 8 with slow-cooker evolves into Fry Fortress at the first chest, and chip-shuriken picked up on the way plus gpu evolves into Kettle Cyclone. Together they were the strongest early build so far.
evidence: L1.I4.G4: fry-fortress at 56 s dealt 13942, kettle-cyclone at 134 s dealt 33566, 2588 kills, 27 damage taken, health 116/120, 7 boss chests and 8 elites killed by 3:00.

claim: A chest-first planner.goal did not fix the minute-5 gym either: it died at 5:20, sooner than the baseline (5:59) and the boss-knob game (5:29). Prompts and knobs alone have not fixed the Masher and elite wave.
evidence: L1.I6.G4 chest-first goal died at 5:20, L1.I5.G5 boss knobs at 5:29, L1.I4.G5 baseline at 5:59. All three used the same thin 98 hp build. The build was too weak for the Masher and elite wave, and prompts and knobs did not change that.

claim: Starch-chain 8 with hot-sauce (Gratin Arc) and hash-hawk 8 with bacon-bits (Hash Harrier) evolve at the first chest within 70 s and are top damage sources. Peel-phantom 8 with peel-out (Peel Poltergeist) is weak by comparison.
evidence: L1.I5.G1: gratin-arc at 69.7 s, 25566 damage, 1680 kills, health 116/120. L1.I5.G2: hash-harrier at 67 s, 13012 damage, 889 kills. L1.I5.G3: peel-poltergeist at 127 s, 3014 damage, 715 kills, 22 dashes at 0.2.

claim: Starting with a dash-only weapon such as peel-phantom, with nothing else to kill with, fails on Nightmare 1: almost no damage, no level-ups and no chests in 3 minutes.
evidence: L1.I6.G3: 44 kills, level 2, 662 damage, 0 chests, health 30/120, 5 dashes only after health fell below 45%. Compare L1.I6.G1 starch-chain, 1342 kills.

claim: Starch-chain is a strong fresh start on Nightmare 1: it evolves into Gratin Arc at the first chests and kills the most of any fresh start so far.
evidence: L1.I6.G1: gratin-arc at 134 s, 13465 damage, 1342 kills, 3 chests, health 110/132. L1.I5.G1 (loadout 8 + hot-sauce): gratin-arc at 70 s, 25566 damage, 1680 kills.

claim: On Nightmare 20 a max-level starting weapon with its catalyst does not survive the opening. Three elites of about 4000 hp arrive at 0:34-1:00, no chest is listed before then, and so no evolution happens.
evidence: L1.I8.G1 starch-chain 8 + hot-sauce died at 95 s, G2 fry-sentry 8 + slow-cooker at 36.6 s (3 Fry Fly elites), G3 hash-hawk 8 + bacon-bits at 73.5 s. All had 0 chests opened and 0 chests listed. L1.I8.G4 fresh starch-chain was at 53/120 at 90 s with 0 chests.

claim: The hard window on Nightmare 1 starts at about 2:00. The amusing boss, Sizzle Imp/Spittlebug elites and the 3:00 Mother of Beetles kill thin builds. The full run was at 21/120 health from 1:56 and died at 3:28.
evidence: Full run: 86 health lost to Sizzle Imp elites at 1:55-1:56, then 2-34 health to the end; Mother of Beetles killed it at 3:27 (41% left). Earlier rehearsal deaths at 2:27-3:28.

claim: Seeker-sprouts with the default playbook is not a reliable start: it only survives when it opens chests and evolves, and the unchanged playbook lived in 0 of 4 loop-2 seeds. It lived 5:00 on seed 23 in loop 1 and reached 5:00 in 3 of 4 loop-2 games once the opening knobs were on.
evidence: Baselines 3:23, 3:08, 0:52 and 3:16 (seeds 31-34) died; seed 35 lived 5:00 with 8 chests and Overgrowth at 155 s. Unchanged seeker-sprouts lived in 1 of 5 loop-2 seeds. Knobs arm: 3 of 5 lived 5:00 (see B35).

claim: The unchanged playbook with a random fresh start usually dies on Nightmare 1 before 3:30. The full run (seeker-sprouts) was a sixth data point: died at 3:28.
evidence: Rehearsal L1.I10.R1-R5: deaths at 147-208 s and one survivor. I9: 1 of 5 survived 300 s. Full run: 208 s.

claim: Fresh fry-knives, steam-vent, fry-sentry and tot-toss do not reliably reach their evolutions on a new seed. All four died between 2:01 and 3:12 in I9, with few chests (0-2) and weak extra weapons. The earlier seed-11 successes (Fry Fortress, Pressure Cooker) came from loadouts that were handed to the game, not from fresh play.
evidence: L1.I9.G1 fry-knives died 2:46 (2 chests), G2 steam-vent 3:12 (1 chest), G4 fry-sentry 2:01 (1 chest), G5 tot-toss 2:40 (0 chests). Compare L1.I4.G4 fry-sentry 8 + slow-cooker on seed 11 (loadout swapped in): Fry Fortress at 56 s, 2588 kills.

claim: The default planner.pick takes a catalyst only when the passive looks attractive: Sour Cream (crit damage) was taken 3 of 3 times offered in the full run, while Fertilizer (XP gain) was rated 14-38% every time. Seeker-sprouts depends on Fertilizer, so it rarely evolves by picks.
evidence: Full run (L2.I10): Sour Cream taken at 1:34 (51%), 3:28 (81%) and 3:29 (63%), and Broadside evolved to Full Broadside at 3:29. L1.I10 full run: Fertilizer offered 6 times, rated 6-38%, never taken. L2.I9 G2 and G3: Fertilizer at 14-26% each time, Seeker Sprouts 8/8 and 7/8 never evolved. In the full run Seeker Sprouts stayed 1/8.

claim: At low health the default planner keeps choosing the evade goal (about 50%) over food and chests (20-48%). Tibo stays under 25% health for minutes, never eats food nearby and never opens listed chests.
evidence: Full run L1.I10 1:56-3:27: 14 evade plans, 'Eat the food' 24-48% against evade 45-60%, 6+ chests listed and never opened, health 21/120 for most of the time. Repeated in L4.I10 1:56-3:09: 11 evade goals at 6-40% health, Eat the food 23-39% against evade 49-54%, chest 127 away rated 30% against evade 40% at 9 hp, 0 health gained, 37 s at 6-8 hp, 7 dashes at 6-13% health.

claim: Fighting Sizzle Imp elites (exploders) on a chest at full health can cost most of Tibo's health in about 2 seconds. Every move was ruled out by the forecast, so the action model had no safe step.
evidence: Full run 1:55-1:56: -17, -17, -35, -17 hp (120 to 34) from Sizzle Imp while standing on a chest; all eight directions rated hurt about 3 or ruled out.

claim: Surveys on one seed (11), in 180 s games or from handed-over loadouts overstate how well a start works. Judge starts and prompts on at least 3 fresh seeds from 0:00 and 300 s.
evidence: L1.I1-I8 seed 11: almost every start survived 3:00. L1.I9 seed 23 fresh: 1 of 5 survived 300 s. L1.I10 rehearsal: 1 of 5. Full run: died 3:28.

claim: Listed chests and elite kills are not turned into opened chests. Four of five L2.I1 seeker games opened 0 chests, and one game listed a chest at 0:55 and killed 3 elites by 2:00 without opening any.
evidence: L2.I1.G2 seed 32: first chest listed 0:55, 3 elites killed by 2:00, 0 chests opened, died 3:08. G3, G4 and G5: 0 chests, first chest listed never. G1: its single chest was opened at 1:24 (Hash Hawk 4/8 to 7/8).

claim: Seeker-sprouts on fresh seeds can die in the opening (0:52-1:20) to Fry Fly elites in the fry-oil-desert, with no chest and fewer than 130 kills.
evidence: L2.I1.G3 seed 33 died at 0:52 (Fry Fly 87.7 damage, 87 kills). L2.I1.G4 seed 31 died at 1:20 (Fry Fly 72.6, 125 kills) while the baseline on seed 31 lived to 3:23.

claim: Gold goes unused: runs earned about 200 gold by 3:00 with no purchases shown, and the default planner never sees prices or spot types when rating goals.
evidence: L2.I1.G1 goldEarned 202.8, full run goldEarned 212.7. Neither run reports gold spent. The default planner.state does not include {{spots}}.

claim: A spot-first planner (spots, elites and schedule in the state, goal prompt rating free-power spots above exploring) did not give more power or a longer life than the default on fresh seeker-sprouts seeds.
evidence: L2.I2.G1-G3 died at 1:44, 1:34 and 0:59 against baselines L2.I1.G1-G3 at 3:23, 3:08 and 0:52. Seed 32 opened 4 chests by 1:34 but died to Cave Grubs (103 damage) at 132 max hp. Only 1 paid crate (30 gold) per game.

claim: The low-health goal prompt with eliteMinHp 0.5 looked strong on one gym (damage 37 against 114), but from 0:00 it lived 1 of 3 fresh seeds and the later chest-first variant lived 1 of 4. It is not worth adding to the playbook.
evidence: L2.I2.G5 gym: 4413 kills, 37 damage. L2.I3 from 0:00: lived seed 31 only, died 2:00 and 0:27. L2.I9 chest-first goal with the same food rule: lived 1 of 4.

claim: Elite pests that arrive early (0:15-1:05) kill seeker-sprouts starts in the opening on some fresh seeds (31 and 33) before any chest is opened.
evidence: Seed 33: L2.I1.G3 died 0:52 (Fry Fly 87.7), L2.I2.G3 died 0:59 (Potato Beetle 86.9 plus Wireworm Larva 81, elites at 0:15). Seed 31: L2.I1.G4 died 1:20 (Fry Fly 72.6), L2.I2.G1 died 1:44 (Fry Fly 78, elites at 1:02). The seed 31 baseline lived to 3:23.

claim: Handing over cheap base items turned seeker-sprouts games on seeds where the playbook died into games that lived to 4:00-5:00. Over s31-33 and s35 the handed-item games lived 7 of 7 against 0 of 4 for the playbook on those seeds. The loadouts are handed over at 0:00, so this is an upper bound, not a playbook change.
evidence: 5-item bundle on s31, s32 and s33 lived 5:00 (3028, 2843, 2431 kills). L4.I3: armor+hp items on s33 (273 damage, Overgrowth 217 s) and s35 (80 damage, Mash Avalanche 173 s) lived 4:00; on-hit items on s33 (207 damage, Waffle Cut 71 s) and s35 (65 damage, 2204 kills) lived 4:00. Playbook on s33 and s35 died 3:05 and 2:39. Handed games take different chest and RNG paths, so some of the gain may be luck.

claim: The low-health goal prompt with eliteMinHp 0.5 does not stop opening deaths: two of three fresh seeds still died by 2:00.
evidence: L2.I3.G1 seed 31 lived 5:00 (71 damage); G2 seed 32 died 2:00 (Cave Grub 90.5); G3 seed 33 died 0:27 (Fry Fly 91.5) with 3 model-asked moves. Baselines died at 3:23, 3:08 and 0:52.

claim: Boss-aware knobs (distrustBossRange 220, bossOfferRange 220, bossDashRange 200, bossDashThreshold 0.3) cut boss damage on the 1:40 seeker gym (one game) but did not help on a real build from 5:00 to 10:00, and the bot did not dash.
evidence: L2.I3.G5 on gym seeker-nm1-100s: boss damage 31 against 71, 0 dashes. L2.I6.G5 against G4 on gym seeker-knobs-5min-s31 (5:00-10:00): total damage 131 against 91, no boss damage from the Masher or Late Blight worth noting, 0 dashes, both lived. No sign of a benefit.

claim: distrustSeconds 10 with forecastSeconds 1 made the opening safer with seeker-sprouts: over 10 paired fresh seeds it outlived the old default on 8 and lived 5:00 on 6, against 2 for the old default. The full run on that playbook reached 6:43 (3:28 for the previous playbook).
evidence: L2.I5-I7 pairs: 4 of 5 outlived, 3 of 5 lived 5:00 against 1 of 5. L2.I10 rehearsal on 5 new seeds: knobs lived 3, old lived 1. Full run L2.I10: lived 6:43, 120/120 at 5:00 with 7 chests, Full Broadside at 3:29.

claim: Handing over 300 gold with a spend-first planner bought random paid crates that gave junk and did not help survival.
evidence: L2.I4.G3 seed 31: 217 gold spent on 3 paid crates giving Lucky Peel, Chive Charm and Gem Sling (plus Hash Hawk and Potato Rain from level-ups). It opened 0 real chests, took 91 damage between 1:00 and 2:00 and died at 2:14 to the Amusing boss, against 3:23 for the baseline on the same seed. One game.

claim: Ground hazards (Brambles, Spore vent, Hot oil) cost 40-50 health in some 300 s games, up to a quarter of all damage taken, and no experiment has looked at them yet.
evidence: L2.I4.G5 seed 32: Brambles 48.7 of 96. L2.I4.G2 seed 32: Brambles 41.6 of 200. L2.I4.G4 seed 33: Spore vent 51.3 of 177. L2.I1.G1 seed 31: Hot oil 42.2 of 201.

claim: Showing standing_on, hazards and hurt_by to the action model with a hazard-naming hurt prompt cut ground damage on seeds 32 and 35 but not consistently on seeds 31, 33 and 34.
evidence: Seed 32: Brambles 9.7 against 41.6. Seed 35: Hot oil 10 against 40. Seed 31 (L2.I7.G1): Hot oil 27.2, died 4:03. Seed 33: Hot oil 9 and Brambles 12.4. Seed 34: Hot oil 57.3 and Brambles 11.4, so no clear cut there. Survival with the prompt was 3 of 5 at 5:00 (seeds 32, 33, 34), the same as knobs alone.

claim: A focus-and-defense planner.pick did not help on seed 33: with knobs it died at 2:43 with 0 chests opened and 261 kills, against 3:05 for knobs alone.
evidence: L2.I5.G4: Fertilizer taken at 1:20 and Peel Out at 1:36, seeker-sprouts 5/8, no chest ever listed, 86 health lost in the minute before the Amusing boss at 2:43. One game and no chests came up, so the pick text itself was barely tested.

claim: A seeker-sprouts build that reaches 5:00 with evolutions and chests scales through 10:00 on Nightmare 1: full health most of the time and under 135 damage taken in five minutes with 9-10k kills.
evidence: L2.I6.G4 (knobs) and G5 (boss knobs) from the 5:00 gym on seed 31: 8879 and 9766 kills, damage 91 and 131, health 138/138 and 110/132 at 10:00. Damage came from hash-harrier, russet-ricochet and hashnado; 13 chests opened in each, 17 and 13 boss chests.

claim: With hazards and standing_on in the action state the bot dashes much more (20-23 dashes on seeds 31 and 34), often at 56-70% health near the amusing boss, but it is unproven that this helps.
evidence: L2.I7.G3 seed 34: 23 dashes from 2:02, health 56-74%, lived 5:00 (amusing damage 3.3). L2.I7.G1 seed 31: 20 dashes, most at 15-43% health, died 4:03. L2.I7.G2 seed 33: 7 dashes, amusing damage 5.5, lived. L2.I6.G3 seed 35: 16 dashes, amusing 18.8, died 4:04. Amusing damage was 3-35 in these games against 73 in the knobs game on seed 35.

claim: Gold goes unspent late even in strong runs: the 10:00 gym game held 2089 gold with 4 paid crates bought, and the planner has no rule to spend it.
evidence: L2.I6.G4: goldEarned 2144, goldSpent 551 (Potato Crate 436). L2.I6.G5: earned 1501, spent 187. Gold is not an issue before 4:00, where it is only 30-400 and early crates gave junk (B36).

claim: At the 4:00 Masher a seeker build with 120 max hp and few kills dies even with the hazard prompt. Survivors had an evolution by about 3:15 and 2400-5700 kills.
evidence: L2.I7.G1 seed 31: 853 kills, 1 chest opened, no evolution, 4/120 health from 3:00, died 4:03. L2.I6.G3 seed 35: 1881 kills, Dynamo Coil at 155 s, died 4:04 to the Masher (44.8 damage). Survivors: seed 33 Overgrowth at 133 s (5756 kills), seed 34 Waffle Cut at 192 s (2411 kills), seed 32 Eclipse Scythe at 115 s (2561 kills).

claim: A catalyst-first planner.pick evolved Overgrowth sooner on the seeker gym (111 s against 227 s), but from 0:00 on seeds 31-34 it lived 1 of 4 against 3 of 4 for knobs alone, so the gym lead did not carry over.
evidence: Gym L2.I7.G5 against G4: Overgrowth 111 s against 227 s, one game each. From 0:00 (L2.I8): seed 31 died 2:08 (0 chests), seed 32 died 3:02 (0 chests, Fertilizer taken twice but seeker-sprouts only 5/8), seed 33 died 2:32 (1 chest), seed 34 lived 5:00 (6 chests, Wildfire Roast 105 s, Overgrowth 206 s). Knobs alone: 5:00, 5:00, 3:05, 5:00.

claim: The catalyst-first pick text does not help while chests are missing. Three of four fresh games opened 0-1 chests by 2:00 and died by 3:02 whatever the picks were.
evidence: L2.I8.G1-G3: chests opened by 2:00 were 0, 0 and 0 (G3 opened its first at 2:07). Deaths at 2:08, 3:02 and 2:32. G4 opened 2 chests by 2:00 and lived with two evolutions.

claim: A seeker-sprouts build that reached 10:00 on the playbook lives through 15:00 at full health. Nothing hurts it much between 10:00 and 15:00, and gold piles up unspent.
evidence: L2.I8.G5 from gym seeker-knobs-10min-s31: alive at 15:00, health 174/174, 37431 kills, 230 damage taken (Ice Imp 52, Harvest Mouse 53, Mud Golem 49 in one 49-damage burst at 14:43). Gold earned 6918, spent 1389 on 4 Potato Crates. Similar to L2.I6 (10:00 at 138/138).

claim: Reaching 2:00 without an opened chest still predicts an early death, but chests are not enough: survivors in the rehearsal also had an evolution by about 2:00 or a coherent damage build. Four chests by 2:00 with scattered picks still died at 3:26.
evidence: Rehearsal playbook: R2a Overgrowth at 117 s lived (5027 kills), R3a Cast Iron at 114 s lived, R1a golden-harvest only at 277 s but survived on shield and rain, R4a evolved at 231 s and died 4:07, R5a 0 chests died 2:06. L2.I9.G2: 4 chests by 2:00, died 3:26 with no evolution.

claim: A chest-first planner.goal (open chests above 35% health, elites only above 50%, food first below 40%) did not beat the knobs alone from 0:00: it lived 1 of 4 against 3 of 4. Opening more chests did not save thin or scattered builds.
evidence: L2.I9 seeds 31-34 against knobs-only games: seed 31 died 2:28 (1 chest, Hot oil 43, amusing 63), seed 32 died 3:26 (4 chests by 2:00, Beetle Brood 43, Seeker Sprouts 8/8 with no Fertilizer), seed 33 died 3:35 (2 chests by 2:00, Seeker Sprouts 7/8 with no Fertilizer), seed 34 lived 5:00 (12 chests, Hash Harrier at 136 s). Knobs alone: 5:00, 5:00, 3:05, 5:00. Fertilizer offered 5+ times in each of games 2 and 3 at 14-26%.

claim: A seeker build that lived to 15:00 at 174/174 health died at 18:23 to tier 5 Grease Fiend elites and Ice Imp/Mud Golem bursts (174 max hp, 0 dashes, 15k gold unspent). A 240 hp, armor 100 build lived to 20:00 in 4 of 4 games (B90), so max HP and armor probably decide the 17:00-20:00 window.
evidence: L2.I9.G5 from gym seeker-knobs-15min-s31: died at 18:23, 46821 kills, damage taken 902 (Grease Fiend 669, Ice Imp 129, Field Rat 57, Mud Golem 35). Health fell from 174 to 23 in the 18:00 minute; one burst of -122 at 17:33. 380 peak enemies, model lag 65 ms (p90 112). One game.

claim: Fry-oil-desert and chip-canyons openings kill seeker-sprouts builds in the first 2:30 when no chest has been opened: Fry Fly elites, Hot oil, Oil Drip and the amusing boss take most of the health.
evidence: Rehearsal R5a seed 1COCSL5 died 2:06 (Hot oil 55, Fry Fly 38, 0 chests) and R5b died 2:10 (Fry Fly 39, amusing 58). L2.I9.G1 seed 31 died 2:28 (Hot oil 43, 1 chest). L2.I3.G3 seed 33 died 0:27 (Fry Fly 91). Compare B27 and B31.

claim: Chest rewards raise the leading weapon, which concentrates damage; the planner also takes a repeated weapon at 50-77% once it holds it. Chests are the main source of weapon levels on Nightmare 1, but they only helped late in this run (first opened at 1:35).
evidence: L3.I10 full run: Seed Potato 1/8 to 6/8 from level-ups at 0:10-1:26 (rated 50-77%) plus chest levels at 1:35 and 1:52, other four weapons stayed at 1/8; died 2:07. Earlier: L2.I10 Full Broadside 54% of damage; L3.I7 Spud Lob 3/8 to 7/8 from a chest.

claim: A build with 120 max hp, four of six weapons at 1/8 and no HP or armor passives dies in the 6:00-7:00 crowd even when one evolved weapon does half the damage.
evidence: Full run: died 6:43 at 120 max hp. Seeker Sprouts, Starch Bolt, Skillet Flail and Spud Lob at 1/8. Passives Chives 2, Sour Cream 3, Packed Pan 3, Gravy Splash 1, Starch Plating 1, GPU 2. Armor only from shrines (24). Lost 143 health in the 6:00 minute (Bog Toad 62.9, Blight Spore 39.6 in total). Compare 15:00 gym build with 174 hp that was untouched until 17:00.

claim: At full health the default planner rates evade above open-the-chest, so reachable chests are left behind for minutes and the build stalls.
evidence: Full run: no chest opened 4:04-6:27 (143 s). At 5:29-5:30 at 116-120/120 health chests 112 and 119 away rated 27-29% against evade 50-53% and were never opened. At 4:17 a chest 98 away was left. 14 chests seen, 7 opened; 21 evade goals finished, 9 between 4:20 and 5:30.

claim: A dashThreshold of 0.5 holds the dash back until health is under about 35%. Lowering it to 0.3 from 0:00 on s31-35 did dash earlier (health 50-76% in some games) but did not raise survival (B78), so a late dash is not the main cause of opening deaths.
evidence: Full run L3.I10: 12 dash asks scored 17-43% during the 1:05-1:10 burst (health 110 to 36) and none fired; the first dash was at 1:12 at 30% health, then 6 more at 8-22% health. L2.I10 dashes only at 6:30. L3.I4 gym: dash 0.3 took 113 and 109 damage against 14 and 249 at 0.5.

claim: Gold is not turned into power: the first Potato Crate costs 30 gold but 675 gold was earned and 0 spent, and the one crate trip walked into a growing crowd and was cut off by the boss.
evidence: Full run: gold held 607 at 6:00 with the crate at 30 gold, goal 'Charge the Potato Crate' 5:51-6:00 dropped at 0.1 of 1.5 s charged when Late Blight appeared; gold spent 0 for the run; crate goals rated 31-48% at 5:51-6:00. Also B28, B42.

claim: Food and crate goals taken while 90-130 enemies are on screen cost health that evade would have kept: 29 health was lost on the 6:08-6:15 food goal.
evidence: Full run 6:08-6:15: 'Eat the food' 40% over Tater Lantern 34%, health 107 to 78 with 88-100 enemies and Late Blight pools; the second food at 6:15 gave +30 but 6:19-6:27 evade lost another 25. Enemies 130 at 6:00.

claim: Gyms built from surviving builds and single-game gym leads mislead: three gym leads flipped on fresh seeds, and the 10:00-15:00 safety of strong builds did not apply to the typical thin 5:00 build.
evidence: Low-health gym 37 against 114 damage then 1 of 3 and 1 of 4 lived from 0:00; catalyst-first gym Overgrowth 111 s against 227 s then 1 of 4 against 3 of 4; boss knobs gym 31 against 71 damage then no benefit. The plan predicted scaling through 15:00; the full run died at 6:43 with 120 hp.

claim: The seeker-sprouts baseline with the playbook knobs on fresh seeds 31-35 is 5:00, 5:00, 3:05, 5:00 and 2:39 (3 of 5 lived), and starch-bolt matches it (3 of 5). A start needs to beat 3 of 5 on the same seeds to enter the playbook, so no alternative has qualified.
evidence: L3.I1-I3 paired games: starch-bolt 3 of 5, spud-lob 1 of 3, spud-cannon 0 of 3 against seeker 3 of 5.

claim: Spud-lob with the opening knobs is no better than seeker-sprouts: it lived 1 of 3 fresh seeds, and the deaths had no chest and no evolution.
evidence: L3.I1.G1 s31 died 2:24 (0 chests), G3 s33 died 2:03, G2 s32 lived 5:00. Seeker with knobs on the same seeds: 5:00, 5:00, 3:05. Not worth more seeds.

claim: Starch-bolt with the knobs lives 3 of 5 fresh seeds, exactly the same as seeker-sprouts on the same seeds (3 of 5). It reaches evolutions by 2:25-3:10 when chests come, but it is not more reliable and it does not justify a start change.
evidence: Starch-bolt: s31 5:00, s32 died 4:21 (Masher), s33 5:00, s34 5:00 (Thunder Tuber 145 s, 2854 kills), s35 died 2:14 (amusing 73, 2 chests). Seeker with knobs on s31-35: 5:00, 5:00, 3:05, 5:00, 2:39.

claim: Spud-cannon with the opening knobs does not reach 5:00 on fresh seeds: it died on all three with 1-2 chests and no evolution.
A longer exploreDistance (700) may bring chests sooner. Over four seeds it lived 2 of 4, the same as knobs alone, and it did not stop opening deaths.
evidence: Seeker explore 700: s31 5:00 (7 chests, 41 damage), s33 5:00 (4 chests), s34 died 2:38 (1 chest, amusing 106), s35 died 2:45 (0 chests, Tomato Leech 90). Knobs only on the same seeds: 5:00, 3:05, 5:00, 2:39 (2 of 4). Mixed on chests and no survival gain.

claim: On Nightmare 1 the opening still kills 1-in-3 starts around 1:15-2:45 to an elite or the 2:00 amusing boss when 0-1 chests are open, whatever the start weapon or explore distance. Dashes come late (health under 35%).
evidence: L3.I3.G4 seeker s34: 1 chest at 1:49, amusing 106 damage 2:09-2:12, died 2:38, 5 dashes all under 10% hp. G5 seeker s35: Tomato Leech elite took 90 hp at 1:15-1:23 with 0 chests, died 2:45, 11 dashes at 0-33% hp. G2 starch s35: amusing 73, died 2:14, 2 dashes at 34%. Also L3.I1 spud-lob s33 died 2:03.

claim: A dashThreshold of 0.3 in the 5:50 crowd window dashes 4-6 times in 200 s at 51-81% health and lived 2 of 2, but it did not clearly cut damage against the playbook (113 and 109 against 14 and 249). It is not shown to help.
evidence: L3.I4 gym starch-knobs-350s, 200 s: baseline A lived with 14 damage and 0 dashes; baseline B died 8:21 to the Fryer King (123 damage, 0 dashes); dash 0.3 A lived with 113 damage and 6 dashes at scores 31-43%; dash 0.3 B lived with 109 damage and 4 dashes. The build was strong (thunder-tuber, 120 hp), so it is unlike the thin 5:50 build.

claim: An HP-and-levels-first planner.pick text did not help the 5:50 gym: it died at 7:07 after taking Reroll over Hot Sauce and Damage over Cooldown, with only 1 chest opened. The pick text was barely tested.
evidence: L3.I4.G5: died 7:07 (Sir Strawman 81, Hot oil 34, Late Blight 26), 1976 kills against 5447-7924 in the other arms, 1 chest, 0 dashes. One game.

claim: Autopilot 1 (forecast-only mover, no action model) is worse than the playbook knobs from 0:00: it lived 5:00 on 1 of 5 fresh seeds against 3 of 5, and it never dashes. Deaths were thin openings with 0-2 chests.
evidence: L3.I5 seeker autopilot: s31 died 3:41 (Mother of Beetles, 185 damage), s32 died 3:28 (0 chests, Snow Mold), s33 lived 5:00 (42/120 hp, Overgrowth at 260 s), s34 died 2:33 (amusing 66.5, 1 chest), s35 died 2:28 (0 chests, 165 kills). Knobs with the action model on s31-35: 5:00, 5:00, 3:05, 5:00, 2:39. Autopilot also drops the distrustSeconds check the knobs rely on (B35).

claim: planEvery 10 did not help: it lived 3 of 5 fresh seeds, the same as planEvery 5 (3 of 5), and lost two paired seeds. Goals were still dropped.
evidence: L3.I6 seeker planEvery 10: s31 died 3:32 (1 chest), s32 lived (5 chests, Spud Grid 243 s, 211 damage), s33 died 1:30 (0 chests), s34 lived (7 chests, Sack of Russets 202 s), s35 lived at 20/137 (2 chests). Playbook on the same seeds: 5:00, 5:00, 3:05, 5:00, 2:39. s32 still dropped 6 spot goals and 6 explore goals, s34 dropped 3 explore goals.

claim: Withholding fight-the-elite goals before 2:00 (eliteFrom 120) does not help: over s31-35 it lived 2 of 5 against 3 of 5 for the playbook, with 1 paired win, 1 tie and 3 losses.
evidence: L3.I7: s31 5:00 (tie), s33 died 1:16 (loss), s35 5:00 (win). L3.I8: s32 died 3:08 (amusing 105, 1 chest) against 5:00, s34 died 3:15 (amusing 96, 1 chest) against 5:00. Playbook on s31-35: 5:00, 5:00, 3:05, 5:00, 2:39.

claim: A gym saved on an older game build cannot be played unless it is rebuilt. Gym tests planned across iterations can be lost, so a gym is best built and used in the same iteration. The loop manager has since added an automatic rebuild (L3.I8), but it was untested here.
evidence: L3.I7.G4 and G5 on gym seeker-knobs-15min-s31 were not played because the checkpoint was saved on sim-ByUaSHJI.js and the page runs sim-Bxzw-NHo.js. The experiment late-dash-15-to-20 ended inconclusive with no games played.

claim: A hold-levels planner.pick text (catalyst, then top-weapon levels, then HP/armor, new weapons only below 4 held) did not beat the playbook from 0:00 and did not actually concentrate levels: it lived 1 of 3 against 1 of 3, and chest count decided the games.
evidence: L3.I8 s31 died 4:03 (0 chests, Masher, 7/130 hp), s33 died 2:19 (0 chests, Fry Fly 61), s35 lived 5:00 (4 chests, Landmine Harvest 133 s, Overgrowth 247 s, 3027 kills, Seeker Sprouts 4/8 to 7/8 at 3:00). Playbook on s31, s33, s35: 5:00, 3:05, 2:39. s32 and s34 not played, so 4 of 5 paired wins is out of reach.

claim: On Nightmare 1 the 2:00 amusing boss is the most common killer of 120 hp builds with 0-1 chests: it took 96-106 health in about 6 s on s32 and s34, and the first dash fired only at 10-19% health, after the damage was done.
evidence: L3.I8.G1 s32: amusing 105 at 2:03-2:08, first dash 2:08 at 12% health. L3.I8.G2 s34: amusing 96 at 2:03-2:07, first dash 2:07 at 19% health. L3.I3 s34 amusing 106, s35 starch-bolt amusing 73. Compare B63.

claim: Pushing the opening knobs further (distrustSeconds 20, forecastSeconds 1.5) does not beat distrustSeconds 10 and forecastSeconds 1: it lived 2 of 5 fresh seeds against 3 of 5 and lost 3 of 5 pairs. The playbook keeps 10 and 1.
evidence: L3.I9 seeker-sprouts: s31 died 3:12 (Mother of Beetles, 124 damage) against 5:00; s32 died 4:35 against 5:00 (Masher 52, Cave Grub 32, 0 chests opened); s33 lived 5:00 at 9/120 health against 3:05; s34 died 4:11 against 5:00 (amusing 58.8, Masher); s35 lived 5:00 at 149/149 with 9 chests against 2:39. Model-asked moves were 436-976 per game with mean delay about 220-250 ms. Deaths came in the 3:00-4:35 window with 1-2 chests opened, so the extra caution did not fix thin builds.

claim: In the L3.I10 rehearsal the playbook lived 2 of 5 fresh seeds. The two opening deaths (2:26 and 2:32) opened 0 chests although 2 and 4 were seen. Thin openings with unopened chests still decide most games, as they did in B26 and B47.
evidence: R1 seed 9M0QYH died 2:26 (Lint Bunny 69.6, 0 of 2 chests opened, Reset Button taken 4 times, Seeker Sprouts 1/8). R5 seed 1FCLX9H died 2:32 (Amusing boss 28.8, Garden Slug 55.7, 0 of 4 chests opened). R4 died 4:42 to the Masher (Hot oil 54, Field Crow 31). R2 and R3 lived 5:00 with 2186 and 2135 kills, 7 chests seen each, and 2 and 3 opened.

claim: On Nightmare 1 the elite burst at 1:00-1:10 can take 70-100 health in about 7 s from a 115/120 start when a fight-the-elite goal walks into two 509 hp elites with several chasers. All forecast moves were ruled out and the dash was asked 12 times at 17-43%, under the 0.5 threshold, so it never fired until 30% health.
evidence: Full run L3.I10: goal 'Fight the Potato Beetle' started 1:04 at 115/120, rated 40% against explore 38%; health 110 to 36 between 1:05 and 1:10 (Potato Beetle 70 damage in the run); first dash 1:12 at 30% health. Also B31, B63, B71. Note B68: removing elite goals before 2:00 did not raise survival over 5 seeds, so the burst is not only an elite-goal problem.

claim: The same playbook (seeker-sprouts, distrust 10, forecast 1) lives very different lengths on the evaluation seed (6:43 and 2:07) and reaches 5:00 on about 8 of 15 fresh seeds. One full run or one 5-seed arm cannot show an improvement smaller than about 40 points.
evidence: Playbook with knobs on s31-35: 5:00, 5:00, 3:05, 5:00, 2:39 (3 of 5); L2.I10 rehearsal 3 of 5; L3.I10 rehearsal 2 of 5; full runs 6:43 (L2) and 2:07 (L3). Loop 3 arms (starch-bolt 3/5, explore 700 2/4, planEvery 10 3/5, autopilot 1/5, eliteFrom 120 2/5, caution 20/1.5 2/5, hold-levels 1/3) all fall inside this noise.

claim: Spud Shrines (armor, max HP, damage) give free power in the first 2 minutes, and the planner picks armor at 62-96% when offered. A shrine-first goal did charge them (134 max hp in 3 of 5 games, armor 29 on s35), but the arm lived no longer than the playbook. Shrines are not the limiting factor for the opening deaths.
evidence: L4.I1: 3 of 5 games reached 134 max hp by 2:00; s31, s32 and s34 still died at 3:12-3:24 with 0-1 chests. See B77.

claim: A shrine-first planner.goal (nearest Spud Shrine within 300 rated high before 2:00 at health above 60%) charges shrines and raises max HP and armor, but it did not raise survival: 2 of 5 were alive at 4:00 against 3 of 5 for the playbook, with 2 paired wins and 3 losses.
evidence: L4.I1 seeker-sprouts 240 s: s31 died 3:24 (0 chests, amusing 80, 134 max hp), s32 died 3:12 (0 chests, 105 lost in the 3:00 minute), s33 alive (1698 kills, Overgrowth 213 s, 3 chests), s34 died 3:24 (Fry Fly, 86 lost in the 3:00 minute, 134 max hp, armor 12), s35 alive (2362 kills, Gratin Arc 167 s, armor 29, 5 chests). Playbook on s31-35: 5:00, 5:00, 3:05, 5:00, 2:39. The arm was better only on the two seeds where the baseline died. Spot goals were still dropped (s32 3, s35 8), and 0-1 chests opened by 2:00.

claim: dashThreshold 0.3 with bossDashThreshold 0.3 and bossDashRange 250 does not raise survival from 0:00: 2 of 5 alive at 4:00 against 3 of 5 for the playbook (2 wins, 1 tie, 2 losses). It dashes earlier and more (6-18 per game) but the thin openings still die, and some dashes fire at 31% scores in calm moments.
evidence: L4.I2: s31 died 3:15 (835 kills, 1 chest at 1:20, Colorado Queen 42.6, 6 dashes), s32 died 2:33 (0 chests, Tomato Leech 80, 13 dashes mostly at 14-28% health), s33 alive 4:00 (Wildfire Roast 190 s, 4 dashes), s34 alive 4:00 (Spud Grid 135 s, 0 dashes, 53 damage), s35 died 3:08 (0 chests, amusing 44.9, 18 dashes, 4 of them at 31-48% scores with 58-76% health). Playbook on s31-35: 5:00, 5:00, 3:05, 5:00, 2:39. Seeds 36-40 not played.

claim: Armor/max-HP items and on-hit/sustain items both carried s33 and s35 to 4:00 with no clear difference between them (273 and 80 damage against 207 and 65). Max HP was not decisive: the 120 hp on-hit game on s33 took less damage than the 192 hp armor game.
evidence: L4.I3.G1 (s33 armor+hp): 192 max hp, 273 damage (Fry Fly 92, Colorado Queen 38), 97/192 at 4:00. G2 (s35 armor+hp): 226 max hp, 80 damage. G3 (s33 on-hit): 207 damage, 120/120, Waffle Cut at 71 s, 6 chests. G4 (s35 on-hit): 65 damage, 2204 kills, 5 chests. Two games per arm.

claim: With 200 handed gold, spots and gold in the planner state and a Fry Cart goal rule, the bot bought items (Fry Cart 323 gold, 3 crates) and lived 4:00 on s35 with 47 damage. This is one game with handed gold, and it opened only 2 chests and ran 16 evade goals, so it is a lead only.
evidence: L4.I3.G5 s35 with 200 handed gold lived 4:00 (47 damage, 2 items bought). The earned-gold version in L4.I4 (no handed gold) bought 0-1 items per game, lived 4 of 5 with 133-253 damage and did not beat the playbook (see B82).

claim: Three cheap handed items (baked-buckler, spud-muffin, porcupine-spud) carried seeker-sprouts to 4:00 on all of s31-35 with 29-61 damage taken. Armor from Starch Plating alone is not the engine (B84): the armor-first picks died on 6 of 8 seeds. The more likely engine is Fry Volcano (porcupine-spud + Starch Plating), which fires 24 piercing quills on every hit taken.
evidence: L4.I4 G1-G5 alive 5 of 5, Fry Volcano at 103-138 s in four. L4.I5 armor-first (Starch Plating up to 4-5 but no porcupine-spud) 2 of 8.

claim: An earned-gold shop planner (spots and gold shown, Fry Cart or crate rated high when gold covers the price) did not beat the playbook: it lived 4 of 5 to 4:00, but took 133-253 damage on four of those seeds, opened only 0-5 chests, bought 1-2 items and ran 13-22 evade goals per game.
evidence: L4.I4.G6-G10 s31-35: alive at 4:00 on s31 (1 chest, 253 damage), s32 (1 chest, 140), s33 (2 chests, 231), s34 (5 chests, 133); s35 died 3:30 (0 chests, 140). Evade goals 17, 15, 20, 13, 22 against 0-4 in the playbook-prompt item games. Items bought: 0, 1, 1, 1, 0. Playbook on the same seeds lived 3 of 5.

claim: Heavy evade goals go with low chests and high damage in the pooled logs, but removing the keep-away goal did not change survival (5 of 8 against 5 of 8, B86). Evading looks like a symptom of a game already in trouble, not a cause.
evidence: L4.I4.G6-G10 evade 17/15/20/13/22 with damage 253/140/231/133/140; loop-manager pool of 145 games; L4.I6 evade-less arm 5/8 alive against playbook 5/8 on s31-38.

claim: An armor-first planner.pick (Starch Plating, then shrine armor/max HP, then HP passives, new weapons only below 3 held) does not raise survival and starves damage: 2 of 8 alive at 4:00 against 4 of 7 for the playbook on s31-37.
evidence: L4.I5: s31 alive (962 kills, Hot oil 52), s32 died 2:30 (0 chests, 216 kills), s33 died 2:55 (0 chests, 220 kills), s34 died 2:54 (200 kills, Tomato Leech 80), s35 died 2:38, s36 died 2:19 (265 kills), s37 died 3:50 (360 kills, 0 chests, Cave Grub 89), s38 alive (starch-chain 5, 1276 kills). Starch Plating was taken at 100% every time offered. Playbook s36 alive 4:00 (1849 kills), s37 died 2:55 (the Masher 95). Playbook on s31-35: 3 of 5 alive at 4:00.

claim: Early damage is not a clean gate: the armor-first arm had low damage and died, but in the damage-first arm damage by 2:00 did not separate survivors from deaths. Chests opened over the whole game (3-7 in survivors, 1-4 in deaths) separated them better.
evidence: L4.I7 damage by 2:00: survivors G2 7953, G4 7965, G6 10842, G7 5922; deaths G1 6087, G3 7133, G5 6227, G8 5748. Whole-game chests opened: survivors 5, 3, 7, 6; deaths 2, 4, 2, 1. Playbook s39 died with 1 chest, s40 lived with 4. Earlier L4.I5: deaths had 2300-4200 by 2:00 with 0 chests.

claim: A planner.goal that rates keeping away from enemies low (evade-less) did not raise survival from 0:00: on s31-38 it was alive at 4:00 on 5 of 8, the same as the playbook (2 wins, 2 losses, 4 ties). Without the keep-away option the bot hopped between equally rated shrines and walked into early elites.
evidence: L4.I6 (240 s, s31-39): alive s31, s33, s34, s35, s38; died s32 2:03 (Spud Shrine hopping 1:29-1:57, 99 health lost in minute 1, 0 chests, amusing boss), s36 0:37 (Cave Grub elites 108 damage during fight goals, 46 kills, 3 passive picks, 0 chests), s37 3:33 (amusing 64, Colorado Queen 39, 3 chests), s39 3:14 (Snow Mold, Crumb Ant, 118 lost in minute 2). Playbook on s31-38: alive s31, s32, s34, s36, s38; dead s33, s35, s37. s39 had no playbook game.

claim: The playbook (seeker-sprouts, distrust 10, forecast 1) was alive at 4:00 on 6 of 10 fresh seeds (s31-40) and reaches 5:00 on about 8 of 20 pooled fresh seeds (rehearsals 3/5, 2/5, 0/5 over three loops). Full runs: 6:43, 2:07, 3:09. Every arm of loops 3 and 4 landed within noise of that or lower. A change needs 8 or more of 10 and a net of 3 or more paired wins.
evidence: Playbook 4:00: s31 yes, s32 yes, s33 no, s34 yes, s35 no, s36 yes, s37 no, s38 yes, s39 no, s40 yes. Arms: evade-less 5/8, shrine-first 2/5, dash 0.3 2/5, armor-first 2/8, shop planner 4/5, damage-first 4/8, steam-vent 1/5, chest-when-near 4/10. L4.I10 rehearsal 0 of 5 at 300 s (deaths 2:11-3:20).

claim: A damage-first planner.pick (Damage card first, new weapons while fewer than 5 held, damage and cooldown passives, catalysts only for weapons at level 6+) does not raise survival from 0:00: 4 of 8 alive at 4:00 against 5 of 8 for the playbook on s31-38 (1 win, 2 losses, 5 ties).
evidence: L4.I7: alive s32 (Tater Twister 218 s, 5 chests), s34 (Locked Gatling 8/8, 3 chests), s36 (7 chests, 10 elites killed), s37 (Full Broadside 209 s, 6 chests); died s31 2:16 (amusing 98.7, 2 chests, 120 hp), s33 3:17 (Fry Fly 41.9, Crumb Ant 38.8), s35 3:27 (amusing 56.5, Sand Crab 26), s38 3:17 (Potato Beetle 48.8, Spore vent 30.4, 1 chest). Playbook s39 died 3:26 (1 chest), s40 alive 4:00 (4 chests, Overgrowth 216 s). The pick text spread across 5-6 weapons and took no HP or armor cards in most games. Max HP was 120-137 and armor 0 in every game.

claim: A fresh steam-vent start with the opening knobs does not survive the opening: alive at 4:00 on 1 of 5 (s35 at 36/120 health) against 3 of 5 for seeker-sprouts on the same seeds. Every game stayed at 120 max hp, armor 0 and 0 chests opened, with the extra weapons at 1-2/8.
evidence: L4.I8 G1-G5: s31 died 3:23 (913 kills, 5 chests listed 0 opened), s32 died 2:52 (Spore vent, amusing 26.6, 477 kills), s33 died 2:02 (Fry Fly 52.9, Sand Crab 44), s34 died 2:53 (Sand Crab 34.9, 682 kills), s35 alive with 36/120 (amusing 83, Mash Wave 5/8). Steam Vent itself stayed at 1/8 in four games. Pressure Cooker never evolved. Chests seen 3, 2, 4, 3 and 6, opened 0 in all five.

claim: A strong evolved build at 15:00 (six evolved weapons, 240 max hp, armor 100) wins Nightmare 1 under the plain playbook: 4 of 4 games lived to 20:00 and the win registered. Dash 0.25 and gold spending gave no survival gain, so the late game is not the bottleneck.
evidence: L4.I8 G6-G9 on gym late-evolved-15min, all alive at 20:00 at full health: playbook A took 196 damage (Ice Imp 142 in one -137 burst at 19:08, Compost Titan 45), playbook B took 4, dash 0.25 took 263 (Ketchup Kraken -104 at 17:08, -128 at 18:17, dashes at 32-38% scores and 47-74% health), gold-spend took 22 and bought 8 crates, Fry Cart and Slots (47k kills against 71-76k). 20:00 Harvester at 86-100% hp. The build was built by loadout, not earned from 0:00.

claim: A minimal chest-when-near planner.goal (open a listed chest within 250 units above 50% health with no elite within 150) does not raise survival from 0:00: 4 of 10 alive at 4:00 against 6 of 10 for the playbook. It cannot create chests, because the first chest is only listed at 1:05-1:37, after the first elites die.
evidence: L4.I9 s31-40, 240 s: alive s32, s33, s36, s37; died s31 2:21 (Fry Fly 80, amusing 73), s34 3:17 (Bowling Ball 97), s35 3:06 (Hot oil 45), s38 2:12 (Cave Grub 48, amusing 58), s39 3:18 (Snow Mold 90, 0 chests), s40 3:29 (amusing 81, Snow Mold 72). Paired against the playbook: 2 wins (s33, s37), 4 losses (s31, s34, s38, s40), 4 ties. Chests opened: survivors 6, 6, 9, 7; deaths 1, 4, 2, 1, 0, 1. First chest listed 1:05-1:37 in every game. Max HP 120-156, dashes 0-3 per game.

claim: The 2:00 amusing boss and the 3:00 Mother of Beetles end most playbook games on a 120 max hp build with armor 0-10. In the L4.I10 rehearsal the playbook lived 0 of 5 at 300 s, dying at 2:11-3:20, and one game with an early evolution (Eclipse Scythe at 79 s) still died at 3:08.
evidence: L4.I10 R1 died 2:16 (amusing 42, Brambles 31), R2 2:11 (amusing 95), R3 3:00 (amusing 64, Garden Slug 11), R4 3:20 (beetle-queen 26, Bowling Ball 16), R5 3:08 (beetle-queen 9, Potato Beetle 71). All five had max hp 120. Armor was 0, 0, 10, 0 and 6. Chests opened 1, 1, 0, 1 and 2. Compare B63, B71 and B73. The same 0-1 chest pattern appears in L4.I9 deaths. Armor-first picks did not fix it (B84).

claim: On Nightmare 1 a goal that holds Tibo in place (charging a shrine, opening a chest, fighting an elite) in the 1:04-1:56 window can cost 80-100 hp in under 11 s when elites arrive or Hot oil is underfoot. The forecast then rules out nearly every move and dash asks score 14-43%, under the 0.5 threshold.
evidence: Full run L4.I10 (3:09): goal 'Charge the Spud Shrine' from 1:36, two Sand Crab elites arrived at 1:43, health 115 to 55 in 7 s and 36 at 1:54, Hot oil underfoot (burn), 14 dash asks at 14-40%, first dash 1:56 at 39% health. Same pattern in the L3.I10 full run (1:05-1:10, 110 to 36, elite-fight goal) and the L1.I10 run (1:55-1:56, 120 to 34, on a chest). The L2.I10 6:43 run avoided it. Dash 0.3 did not raise survival (B78), so the open question is whether leaving the goal when hurt helps.

claim: The default planner spends about half of the first two minutes on shrine trips and takes low-value cards (Gold gain twice with 0 gold spent, Luck, Pickup range, Move speed). The first elites are fought late, so the first chest comes late, and no Armor card was offered in six shrines.
evidence: Full run L4.I10: 6 shrines charged (0:25, 0:36, 0:44, 0:53, 1:28, 1:54) giving +16.8 max HP once, damage +13%, greed +27%; Sand Crab elites seen at 1:01 and killed only at about 1:52-1:54 by accident; first chest listed 1:54 and 0 goal-opened. One run only; the shrine-first arm (B77) did no better than the playbook.

claim: The 'chests opened' line in game stats counts goal-driven openings only. A chest picked up on an evade step is missed (run.bossChests shows it), so earlier counts of 0-1 chests opened may undercount.
evidence: Full run L4.I10: stats say 0 opened of 4 seen, but run.bossChests 1 and Spud Lob 2/8 to 5/8 at 1:56 right after chest C131298 (15 up at 1:54) left the list. In L4.I9 games with goal-driven chests the counts matched bossChests (G1 1, G6 10 of 10).

claim: About 20 single-lever arms of 5-10 seeds in loops 3-4 produced no playbook change. Prompt-text tweaks to the opening planner sit inside the noise of the pooled baseline (about 8 of 20 at 5:00, 6 of 10 at 4:00). Future tests need 10 paired seeds, a continuous metric chosen first and a manipulation check.
evidence: Arms and results: starch-bolt 3/5, spud-lob 1/3, spud-cannon 0/3, explore 700 2/4, planEvery 10 3/5, autopilot 1/5, eliteFrom 120 2/5, hold-levels 1/3, caution 20/1.5 2/5, shrine-first 2/5, dash 0.3 2/5, shop 4/5, armor-first 2/8, evade-less 5/8, damage-first 4/8, steam-vent 1/5, chest-when-near 4/10. Rehearsals 3/5, 2/5, 0/5; full runs 6:43, 2:07, 3:09.
